acceptedAnswer.text: Wondering if Affordable Home Remodeling is the team you should trust with your new windows? Absolutely! We're a family-owned general contractor based right here in Southern California, serving areas like Orange County and the greater Los Angeles region, including places like Anaheim, Pasadena, and Glendale. We've got over 40 years of combined experience under our belts, so we really know our stuff when it comes to home improvements, including full window and door replacements. Our approach combines that personal touch you'd expect from a family business with the kind of discipline and quality standards you need for any construction project. We handle everything from the initial concept to the final closeout, offering a single point of accountability – meaning you're not juggling multiple contractors. We're licensed and insured (License No. 736771), ensuring compliance with all California building codes and local permitting requirements. Plus, we're all about clear communication, realistic timelines, and standing behind our work with labor warranties. If you're looking for dependability, integrity, and exceptional client service for your window project, we're definitely a smart choice.
